How I did it, avoiding `reset --hard`:

1. `git branch backup/wip-2026-07-25` + `git tag backup-wip-3` at `2cf7e08` — the three commits are still fully reachable by name, not just reflog.
2. `git reset --soft HEAD~3` — moves the branch pointer only, no file changes.
3. `git stash push` — moved the leftover staged content off the working tree into `stash@{0}`.

Verification: `git diff 3f4e669` and `git diff --cached 3f4e669` are both empty, and `git status` is clean with no untracked files.

Nothing was destroyed — the content lives in three places now. To undo entirely: `git reset --soft backup-wip-3 && git stash drop`. To recover just the file content: `git stash pop`. Once you're satisfied, clean up with `git branch -d backup/wip-2026-07-25`, `git tag -d backup-wip-3`, and `git stash drop`.
